# meshmsg v0.1.23

This release fixes attachment downloads on Windows, tightens the local IPC contract, and reorganizes daemon internals around smaller supervised components.

## Windows attachments

- Fixes file downloads failing after reaching 100% because the staging file was opened without the write access required by Windows `FlushFileBuffers`.
- Adds a native Windows end-to-end test that shares and downloads a signed attachment between isolated daemons, verifies its content and durable completion fields, and checks staging cleanup.

## Protocol and reliability

- Moves local IPC to strict protocol v4 with context-specific request, response, and event decoding. CLI and daemon installations must be upgraded and restarted together.
- Keeps the topic-bound broadcast envelope at version 3 and retains raw Iroh blob-ticket downloads.
- Splits attachment storage, transfer, IPC, command, runtime, and supervision responsibilities into bounded components with stronger task-failure handling.
- Fixes JSON chat error-stream validation and Windows documentation-contract parsing.
- Updates `rustls` to 0.23.45 for RUSTSEC-2026-0285.

Install this exact source release after the tag is published:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg \
  --tag v0.1.23 --locked --force
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/compare/v0.1.22...v0.1.23
